name: Bash

input.command:
git mv app/composables/useCart.ts app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
sed -i '' "s/Overrides the base layer's legacy \`useCart\`/Replaces the base layer's legacy \`useCart\`/; s/export function useCart()/export function useShoppingCart()/" app/composables/useShoppingCart.ts
for f in app/middleware/cart-not-empty.ts app/composables/useCartTotal.ts app/components/cart/Badge.vue app/components/cart/Item.vue app/pages/cart.vue "app/pages/products/[slug].vue"; do
  sed -i '' "s#import { useCart } from '~/composables/useCart'#import { useShoppingCart } from '~/composables/useShoppingCart'#; s/useCart()/useShoppingCart()/g" "$f"
done
grep -rn "useCart\b" app; git diff --stat; npm run typecheck 2>&1 | tail -15 && npm run build 2>&1 | tail -5
